evidence: The canonical/player-obtainable Lightning Impact research path is associated with PQ142 Basic Reward and 300 Ki.
Xenoverse 2 Character ID evidence distinguishes short ID 1100 as the CaC-usable Lightning Impact variant from short ID 1103 as a separate CaC-unusable Lightning Impact variant.

The cast-exclusive variant is separately documented as a 300-Ki Ultimate associated with Ultra Pack 2; its exact player acquisition endpoint is not inferred from the PQ142 relationship because the variant identity differs.

Current PQ142 relationship data links the canonical skill identity `skill-lightning-impact` to Timespace Tussle; the research boundary therefore keeps the player/canonical endpoint distinct from the cast-exclusive variant.

evidence_boundary: Batch 337 resolves the important variant/CaC boundary for Lightning Impact without changing the canonical relationship layer. The display name is shared, but Xenoverse 2 internal IDs distinguish a CaC-usable short ID 1100 variant from a CaC-unusable short ID 1103 variant. The repository's canonical `skill-lightning-impact` remains the player/PQ142 identity; the cast-only variant remains a research-layer variant rather than an invented duplicate canonical skill.
